name: tz3ygn-tracker-digest
goal: Prove the native Tracker digest reports each project, rolls up Phase 4 workers, and ends with Daniel-owned actions while retaining existing digest data.

evidence: Native text digest shows blocked, flagged, due, queue, chase, and recurring lists; it has no complete per-project totals, notes or ETAs, and no Daniel-only closing list.

The existing digestText repository case has one agent and only checks the legacy slices. Extend its SQLite fixture with explicit and fallback project names, Phase 4 worker items, chronological notes, and flagged and unflagged blockers; extend the existing native CLI route fixture.
